subject: Next steps: Hosted API access + rate/throughput constraints (BrightMart)

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Quick follow-up + items from today's demo (Hosted API)

Hi Samira — thanks again for hopping on the call this morning. Quick recap and the three items we promised to follow up on: 

1) Quickstart / sandbox access: we'll provision a hosted sandbox you can hit from your staging environment. Can you confirm the IP range or VPC egress addresses we should allow for testing?

2) Endpoints & rate model: you mentioned you expect ~5 RPS steady state on inference with spikes up to ~25 RPS during promotions. I attached a short CSV with the sample traffic profile you mentioned (brightmart_expected_traffic_profile.csv) — please confirm if that matches.

3) Compliance & procurement asks: you said procurement will request an SLA/retention note — I attached a short doc (brightmart_sla_request.pdf) to start that conversation.

Next steps I propose:
- I can open sandbox access (10k tokens/day) today if you confirm allowable IPs and the test endpoint pattern you need.
- If Hosted looks like the right fit, we can map an initial endpoint and set rate caps for the sandbox so your QA can validate.

If Hosted doesn't meet peak needs we discussed Dedicated or Private options, but let's validate the sandbox first — it often surfaces the real traffic shape. Available for a quick 20-min sync tomorrow afternoon if useful.

Best,
Olga
Senior Sales Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments: brightmart_expected_traffic_profile.csv, brightmart_sla_request.pdf

From: Samira Khan <samira@brightmart.com>

Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 12:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up + items from today's demo (Hosted API)

Thanks Olga — appreciate the recap. Confirmations below: 

- IPs: please allow our staging egress 34.201.128.0/24 and 44.210.64.0/24 for the sandbox.
- Traffic: the CSV is accurate for month-one expected shape. Steady 4–6 RPS, 20–25 RPS spikes for 45–60 minute promo windows, and occasional bursts up to 40 RPS for up to 5 minutes.
- Rate limits: two clarifying asks — can the Hosted sandbox support per-endpoint caps (so we can limit search-gen separately from chat-gen)? And do you support an allowlist for upstream webhooks/IPs?

Procurement loop: procurement@brightmart.com is cc'd — they'll follow up on the SLA PDF. If you can provide a simple one-pager on retention and audit logs that would help procurement's evaluation.

If Hosted can do per-endpoint caps and IP allowlists, we're inclined to try the Hosted sandbox first.

Thanks,
Samira
Lead Product Manager, BrightMart
